# Highlight palette: approved configuration

The base email review surface uses one default highlight and one exceptional emphasis color.

## Default

==Sun · #FFE08A · ordinary review emphasis==

Use sun for short figures, phrases, and decisions that need attention.

## Special emphasis

=={hot-pink}Hot pink · #FF4FD8 · rare special emphasis==

Use hot pink only when a second, stronger emphasis carries a clear meaning. Do not use it as decoration.

## What to check

- The message remains understandable if either background disappears.
- Highlighted text stays brief.
- Sun remains the dominant highlight.
- Hot pink appears only when its stronger emphasis is intentional.
